# MetricGAN+ official-reference fixture

This suite is generated by
`tools/parity/metricgan_plus_dump_reference.py`. The script imports the pinned
`speechbrain==1.0.3` inference package and the official
`speechbrain/metricgan-plus-voicebank` checkpoint; it does not contain a local
Python mirror of the LSTM or resynthesis pipeline.

The committed fixture set will contain:

- `pcm.f32.bin`
- `features.f32.bin`
- `bilstm.f32.bin`
- `linear1.f32.bin`
- `mask.f32.bin`
- `waveform.f32.bin`
- `manifest.json`
- `SHA256SUMS`

Generation and `vokra-models` consumption run on VAST. Until that run is
available, no numeric files are present and no real-checkpoint parity result is
claimed. The Rust test is opt-in and requires both
`VOKRA_METRICGAN_PLUS_GGUF` and `VOKRA_METRICGAN_PLUS_REFERENCE_DIR`; setting
only one is a hard error rather than a skip.

The bounds were registered before the first run and match the repository FP32
policy: maximum absolute error `0.01`, mean absolute error `0.001`. If the
first result exceeds them, investigate the worst element and frontend/runtime
semantics; do not widen the bounds to make the run green.
